description: Update a webhook's name, avatar, or the channel it posts to. Only provided fields change. Requires the Manage Webhooks permission. Returns a confirmation.

avatar.description: New avatar image URL for the webhook.

channel_id.description: ID (snowflake) of a channel to move the webhook to.

name.description: New display name for the webhook (max 80 characters).

webhook_id.description: ID (snowflake) of the webhook to edit.

name: discord_edit_webhook
